title: ObstaDiff: Generalizable Diffusion Policy Learning via Obstacle-aware Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.10918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imitation learning has achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation, yet most existing approaches assume clean backgrounds and lack explicit mechanisms for obstacle-aware motion generation. Extending such policies to cluttered, real-world scenes with unstructured obstacles remains a key generalization challenge. We present ObstaDiff, a decomposed diffusion-policy framework with a lightweight obstacle-aware visual encoder. ObstaDiff extracts a structured target-obstacle-background representation, enabling the downstream alignment policy to generate end-effector trajectories toward a target-centered bottleneck pose while reasoning about surrounding obstacles. We evaluate ObstaDiff on 61 real-robot greenhouse trials per method (366 executions in total). translated_title: ObstaDiff：基于障碍物感知表征的可泛化扩散策略学习
translated_abstract: 模仿学习在机器人操作领域已取得令人瞩目的成果，然而大多数现有方法都假设背景干净整洁，缺乏显式的障碍物感知运动生成机制。如何将此类策略扩展到包含非结构化障碍物的杂乱真实场景，仍然是一个关键的泛化挑战。我们提出了ObstaDiff，一个配备轻量级障碍物感知视觉编码器的分解式扩散策略框架。ObstaDiff提取结构化的目标-障碍物-背景表征，使下游的对齐策略能够在感知周围障碍物的同时，生成朝向以目标为中心的瓶颈位姿的末端执行器轨迹。我们在每个方法61次真实机器人温室试验（共366次执行）上评估了ObstaDiff。ObstaDiff实现了75.41%的平均任务成功率和8.20%的平均障碍物碰撞率，优于代表性的模仿学习基线方法，并提升了在杂乱场景中的泛化能力。
tldr: ObstaDiff提出了一种带有轻量级障碍物感知视觉编码器的分解式扩散策略框架，通过结构化的目标-障碍物-背景表征，在杂乱真实场景中生成兼顾避障的机械臂轨迹，实现了75.41%的任务成功率并显著降低碰撞率。
